# Real published schema fixtures

Schemas fetched from their published origins on 2026-09-29 for the Phase 0 taxonomy. Full provenance (pinned source URL, SHA-256 of the fetched source, conversion, notes) is in `provenance.json`; verbatim source excerpts are in `src/`.

Conversion kinds: Pydantic/TypedDict docs examples are copied verbatim into `src/<id>.py` and converted with pydantic 2.13.5 (`model_json_schema(mode="validation")`, or `TypeAdapter(...).json_schema(mode="validation")` for TypedDicts); JSON sources are saved byte-for-byte; CORD and CUAD are transcriptions of the dataset label lists quoted in `src/receipt.txt` and `src/contract.txt`.

Leaf props: properties that are not objects or arrays of objects, following `$ref`s (including `medical_intake`'s external `$ref` to `src/medical_intake.user-profile.schema.json`) and array items; nullable `anyOf [X, null]` counts as X; free-form objects without `properties` count as one leaf.
